focuses.name: The Romanian People's Republic
focuses.desc:
THE ROMANIAN PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC: the tree a communist Romania gets after the Soviet flip - about 7 years, as a COLONY of the Soviet Union.

It forks at once on Moscow's choice of ruler:
- THE SOVIET OFFICIAL (Petru Groza): Moscow's own man, a hardliner - Marxist Fundamentalist and Political Commissar - governing on the Soviet embassy's orders: faster Sovietisation, more extraction, less legitimacy.
- THE LOCAL COLLABORATOR (Constantin Ion Parhon, the base game's communist leader): a Romanian communist with a following of his own - slower, but steadier.

Both roads lead through the real history of 1945-52 compressed into the WiF world: the King's abdication, rigged elections, the Sovroms that drain the oil, the Securitate, Pitesti, the Danube-Black Sea Canal, collectivisation and the Baragan deportations.

Effect: spirit 'A Soviet Colony': +10% political power, -15% stability, -20% factory output (Sovrom extraction).

focuses.name: Groza, Moscow's Man
focuses.desc:
Moscow chose a Soviet official: Petru Groza governs Romania on the Soviet embassy's orders, a hardliner who does exactly as he is told.

Available: the Soviet Union chose a Soviet official (Petru Groza).
Effect: +15% political power. -10% stability. Sovietisation focuses 25% faster.

focuses.name: Parhon's Government
focuses.desc:
Moscow chose a local collaborator: Constantin Ion Parhon, the physician and old Romanian socialist, fronts a Party government with a Romanian face.

Available: the Soviet Union chose a local collaborator (Constantin Ion Parhon).
Effect: +10% stability. -10% political power.

focuses.name: The Abdication of the King
focuses.desc:
30 December 1947: the Party's leaders tell King Michael to abdicate, a pistol on the table and troops around the palace. He goes into exile.

Effect: the monarchy is abolished. Monarchist popularity -20%.

focuses.name: The Elections of 1946
focuses.desc:
The bloc wins 70% - and everyone knows the opposition won.

Effect: +10% political power. -10% stability.

focuses.name: The National Democratic Front
focuses.desc:
The Party's coalition of 'democratic' parties: a Romanian front for the new order.

Effect: +10% stability.

focuses.name: The Land Reform of 1945
focuses.desc:
March 1945: the estates over 50 hectares are taken and handed to the peasants - for now.

Effect: +10% stability. +5% recruitable population.

focuses.name: The Trial of Maniu
focuses.desc:
1947: Iuliu Maniu and the National Peasant leaders are sentenced to life. Maniu dies in Sighet prison.

Effect: democratic popularity -15%. -5% stability.

focuses.name: The Securitate
focuses.desc:
August 1948: the Department of State Security is founded, with Soviet advisers in every office.

Effect: +15% political power. -10% stability. Resistance growth -50% in every state.

focuses.name: Pitesti
focuses.desc:
1949-51: in Pitesti prison, political prisoners are forced to torture one another until they 'unmask' themselves - the most brutal re-education experiment in the Eastern bloc.

Effect: +15% political power. -10% stability.

focuses.name: The Church Abolished
focuses.desc:
December 1948: the Greek-Catholic Church is dissolved and its bishops imprisoned; its parishes are given to the Orthodox Church.

Effect: +10% political power. -5% stability.

focuses.name: The Fall of Patrascanu
focuses.desc:
Lucretiu Patrascanu, the 'national' communist who negotiated the 1944 coup, is arrested in 1948 as a Titoist and executed in 1954.

Effect: +10% political power. Communist unity: +5% stability.

focuses.name: The Constitution of 1948
focuses.desc:
A Soviet-model constitution for the People's Republic.

Effect: +15% stability. +10% political power.

focuses.name: War Reparations
focuses.desc:
Romania pays the Soviet Union - in oil, grain, rolling stock and factories.

Effect: -2 civilian factories (dismantled and shipped east). +10% consumer goods.

focuses.name: The Sovroms
focuses.desc:
Joint Soviet-Romanian companies - Sovrompetrol, Sovromtransport, Sovrombanc - that send the profits east.

Effect: -20% local resources (to the Soviet Union). +10% factory output.

focuses.name: The Nationalization of 1948
focuses.desc:
11 June 1948: every factory, mine, bank and insurance company becomes state property overnight.

Effect: +2 civilian factories. -10% stability.

focuses.name: Collectivisation
focuses.desc:
From 1949 the peasants are forced into collective farms; those who resist are 'chiaburi' - kulaks - and are deported or jailed.

Effect: -15% stability. +10% factory output. -10000 manpower.

focuses.name: The Danube-Black Sea Canal
focuses.desc:
1949: a canal dug by tens of thousands of political prisoners - the 'Canal of Death'.

Effect: +2 infrastructure in Dobruja. -15000 manpower. -5% stability.

focuses.name: The First Five-Year Plan
focuses.desc:
1951: heavy industry first, at any cost.

Effect: +3 military factories, +2 civilian factories.

focuses.name: The Baragan Deportations
focuses.desc:
June 1951: 40,000 Serbs, Germans and others from the Yugoslav border are deported to the empty Baragan steppe and left to build villages in the open.

Effect: -20000 manpower. -5% stability. Yugoslavia -25 opinion.

focuses.name: Socialist Industry
focuses.desc:
Steel, tractors and oil for the bloc.

Effect: +10% factory output. +10% research speed.

focuses.name: The Red Army Garrison
focuses.desc:
Soviet divisions stay in Romania 'to protect the lines of communication'.

Effect: +10% stability. Soviet military access.

focuses.name: The Tudor Vladimirescu Division
focuses.desc:
Romanian prisoners of war, re-educated in Soviet camps, formed into a 'volunteer' division.

Effect: 2 infantry divisions with Soviet equipment.

focuses.name: Soviet Advisers
focuses.desc:
A Soviet officer beside every Romanian commander.

Effect: +10% army experience gain. Soviet doctrine cost -50%.

focuses.name: The Romanian People's Army
focuses.desc:
1948: the Royal Army is purged and rebuilt on the Soviet model.

Effect: +10% army organisation. 2 infantry divisions.

focuses.name: T-34s for Romania
focuses.desc:
Soviet tanks, Soviet training, Soviet doctrine.

Effect: +100 medium tanks.

focuses.name: The Soviet Bloc
focuses.desc:
A colony of the Soviet Union, among its other satellites.

Effect: +25 opinion with communist countries.

focuses.name: The Treaty of Friendship
focuses.desc:
1948: friendship, cooperation and mutual assistance with the Soviet Union.

Effect: +10% stability. The Soviet Union +25 opinion.

focuses.name: The Cominform
focuses.desc:
The Cominform moves its headquarters from Belgrade to Bucharest after Tito's expulsion.

Effect: +10% political power. Yugoslavia -25 opinion.

focuses.name: Against Tito
focuses.desc:
Troops on the Yugoslav border, show trials of 'Titoists'.

Effect: +2 land forts on the Yugoslav border. +10% war support.

focuses.name: Stalinist Romania
focuses.desc:
Seven years after the flip, Romania is a Stalinist state in every institution - and a Soviet colony in every account book.

Effect: +15% stability. +10% factory output.
